press.feature.name: Press and reputation
press.feature.desc: CPU reviews, yearly awards and brand reputation.
press.param.instantReviews.tooltip: A CPU review arrives on the day of the release, without the usual delay of 7–21 days. Handy for testing.
press.param.rivalDigest.tooltip: Once a month, one letter with the loudest reviews of the rivals' CPUs. Off: no letter, the archive of reviews still grows.
press.param.reputationAffectsAI.tooltip: The reputation of rival companies also changes how fast their CPUs gain popularity. Off: reputation affects only your company.
press.param.marketColumn.tooltip: Adds a column with the metascore to the market table of the CPU window. Experimental and off: it works after the game is restarted, and if anything goes wrong the column just does not appear.
press.param.debugVerbose.tooltip: The log carries the axes, the reference CPUs and the multipliers for the player's CPUs. Debug build only.
